implementation.determinism: random.Random with per world-field-seed deterministic derived seed; no wall-clock or external input

synthetic_worlds.common: For each race generate observed score x_i iid N(0,1), compute frozen true logits below, then sample exact finishing positions 1-3 without replacement from a Plackett-Luce process using those true logits.
synthetic_worlds.W4: true_logit_i = 0.25*x_i + 0.35*r_i, where r_i is deterministic within-race rank feature from +1 highest score to -1 lowest score

references.REF_UNIFORM: uniform probability at each sequential finishing-position draw
references.REF_BASE_SCORE_PL: Plackett-Luce with logit=x_i at each sequential draw

R2_SCORE_ONLY_FLATTENED_ORDER_MODEL.formula: At every sequential draw, q_i=(1-uniform_mix)*softmax(x)_i + uniform_mix/remaining_field_size

metrics.ordered_top3_nll: mean -log product of sequential probabilities assigned to actual positions 1,2,3
metrics.top1_accuracy: argmax winner probability equals actual winner
metrics.unordered_top3_containment: predicted top3 set equals actual first-three set
metrics.toplabel_ece10: 10 equal-width bins of maximum winner probability; weighted absolute gap between mean confidence and top1 correctness
metrics.sanity: all winner probabilities finite/nonnegative, winner mass within 1e-12 of 1, ordered-top3 NLL finite

eligibility_and_winner_rule.ranking: among eligible candidates minimize pooled ordered_top3_nll, then pooled winner_logloss, then pooled winner_brier, then candidate_id lexical order

post_execution_rule: Do not alter worlds, grids, seeds, thresholds, metrics, or winner rule after scoring. If one winner exists, freeze it and require a new preregistration plus a new exact Owner Gate before any protected real evaluation. If none exists, record NO_SYNTHETICALLY_ELIGIBLE_REPLACEMENT and do not widen the family post hoc.
